text:
devon: hey all 👋 Devon here (joining infra). quick checklist: where's the single source of truth for who owns what service and the escalation contacts? also blocked on VPN + Confluence access. who do i ping, and if a pager fires before i'm fully onboarded who should I escalate to?

mia (people-ops): welcome Devon! 🎉 primary owner map is the Confluence Team Directory -> Service Owners. eng-platform maintains the canonical copy and we sync it to the owners API. i'll add you to Confluence now. for VPN, security handles tokens — ping security with your employee email.

oliver (eng-platform): hi Devon — adding that we publish a machine-readable export at https://redwood.internal/api/owners.json (includes primary PD contact and EM fallback). we also keep a small "who-to-ping" tab with escalation steps for each service. i'll grant you read access to the API.

devon: thanks. i tried opening the Confluence link and it 403'd.

mia (people-ops): sending invite now and DMing you the onboarding checklist. for temporary badge requests email facilities@redwood.com and CC me; usually same-day for temp badges.

security: @devon — for VPN run `vpn-client login` and you'll get redirected to OIDC. if you see "access denied" it's because your security group hasn't been attached yet. reply here with your employee email and we'll kick the role grant. note: secret write access requires manager approval + security ack.

devon: got it. quick follow-up: if a prod alert hits before I have PD access, what is the right escalation path?

sre-oncall: page #eng-oncall with the subject line "coverage request - <service> - <brief reason>" and include whether you can access the console. someone will take it. if there's no ack in 10 minutes, escalate to the EM oncall listed next to the service in the owners JSON.

oliver (eng-platform): to be explicit: owners.json entry has fields: service, primary_team, primary_pd, em_oncall. use primary_pd first, then em_oncall. we also publish the EM rotation calendar in the Confluence page.

devon: perfect — last question: where are repo codeowners and infra runbooks? want to bookmark them.

oliver (eng-platform): codeowners live per repo at `.github/CODEOWNERS`. we have a cross-repo index in the owners API under `repo_codeowners`. runbooks are in Confluence -> Runbooks and also mirrored to https://runbooks.redwood.internal. if you need a list, ping me and i'll export the important ones for your team.

facilities: @devon for building access, email facilities@redwood.com with name, emp id, and visit date. temporary badge requests get processed same-day usually; permanent badge takes a bit longer. CC people-ops if you need it expedited.

mia (people-ops): added a note to your checklist to follow up on badge/VPN. also FYI: we add new engineers to the owners-contributors group so you can edit the owner map if your team needs corrections.

devex-bot: Access tasks created: AT-20260330-9 (Confluence invite), AT-20260330-10 (Owners API read), AT-20260330-11 (Temporary badge).

devon: amazing, thanks everyone — will accept invites and file any follow-ups if needed. :thumbsup:
